interface.signature: def solve(T: int, test_cases: list) -> list[int]: ...

preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 30 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= N <= 100 for (N, markers, edges) in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, the number of vertices N must be between 1 and 100 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(len(markers) == N for (N, markers, edges) in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, the number of markers must equal N.

preconditions.expression: all(marker in {0, 1, 2} for (N, markers, edges) in test_cases for marker in markers)
preconditions.description: Each marker in the bag must be 0, 1, or 2.

preconditions.expression: all(len(edges) == N - 1 for (N, markers, edges) in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, the number of edges must be exactly N - 1.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= N and 1 <= v <= N for (N, markers, edges) in test_cases for (u, v) in edges)
preconditions.description: For each test case, all vertices in edges must be between 1 and N inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(u != v for (N, markers, edges) in test_cases for (u, v) in edges)
preconditions.description: For each test case, no edge connects a vertex to itself.

postconditions.description: The result must contain exactly one integer per test case.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(answer, int) for answer in result)
postconditions.description: Each answer must be an integer.
Each answer must be a non-negative integer.

postconditions.expression: all(any(assignment == sorted(markers) for assignment in permutations(markers)) and max(abs(assignment[u-1] - assignment[v-1]) for (u, v) in edges) == answer for (N, markers, edges), answer in zip(test_cases, result))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the answer must be the minimum possible unattractiveness, defined as the maximum absolute difference between markers assigned to connected vertices in the tree. The assignment must be a permutation of the given markers.
